column1: # Width budgets only, no English changes (claude/fit-two-line-budgets, 2026-11-06): Quick access names volt:max 64dp@12sp*2 (QuickAccessGrid wraps them onto two lines of whole words), maintenance_badge_soon 72dp@10.5sp like SNOOZED in its row, and the Home lock bar's state lines get budgets (main_lock_state_unknown 220dp@16sp*2; main_lock_locked, main_lock_unlocked, ble_status_connecting 220dp@16sp; main_lock_last_known, main_lock_last_known_word_locked, main_lock_last_known_word_unlocked 220dp@13sp); DashboardModelTileTest asserts the new Quick access budget.

# Width metadata only, no English changes (claude/l10n-qa-overflow-short, 2026-11-06): the 18 Quick access full names (dashboard_model_qa_* with volt:ladder="full") get volt:overflow="short", since QuickAccessGrid.measureContent shows the _short rung in the same 64 dp room where the full name does not fit (the shortcut picker and Settings sheet rows are full width); check.py then lets a full name over 64dp@12sp*2 pass, with a warning, when its short rung fits that budget. No source_sha1 changes; DashboardModelTileTest asserts the attribute and the fallback.

# New strings only, no changes to existing English (claude/recording-pill, 2026-11-06): riding mode's status pill turns into a red recording pill while a ride records (owner request). New keys riding_status_recording, riding_status_recording_reconnecting(_short), riding_status_recording_not_connected(_short) (full rungs volt:overflow="short"; the last rung reuses riding_status_reconnecting or riding_status_not_connected_seen_compact) and the plurals riding_status_recording_spoken_seconds / _minutes (TalkBack). RecordingPillTest asserts the English.

# Width budgets only, no English changes (claude/maintenance-row-budget, 2026-11-06): the Scooter tab's Reminders row values maintenance_row_count and maintenance_row_due go from volt:max 96dp@14sp to 120dp@14sp. MainActivity.SettingLine puts the value on its own line under the label when the two don't fit side by side; there it has about 221 dp at 344 dp wide (344 - 36 page - 24 card - 21 chevron - 42 icon indent), so 120 dp at 14 sp still fits at the largest app text size (1.8x = 216 dp). No source_sha1 changes.

# New strings only, no changes to existing English (claude/recording-pill, Codex review and owner answers, 2026-11-06): after a recording stops the riding status pill briefly confirms the save. New keys riding_status_ride_saved / _short ("Ride saved", "Saved") and riding_status_ride_saved_auto / _short ("Ride saved automatically", "Ride saved"; the full rung volt:overflow="short", the last rung reuses riding_status_ride_saved_short). The retired top-bar Record choice had no catalog text; saved layouts map it to the status pill (RidingLayoutTest).
